Tulips are among the most beloved spring flowers, known for their bright colors and elegant shape. Originally from Central Asia, they became widely popular in the Netherlands during the 17th century, a period known as "Tulip Mania." Today, tulips symbolize perfect love, rebirth, and the arrival of spring. They come in nearly every color except true blue, and each color carries its own meaning — red for true love, yellow for cheerful thoughts, and purple for royalty. The original Schofield's Flowers flower shop had deep ties to the Chicago mob and the Saint Valentine's Day Massacre. If you saw our last video, you know that Dean O'Banion was business partners with my grandfather and used his shop as a front. After the massacre, the shop was deeply impacted and we did the floral arrangements for all the mob funerals.  Now we're just doing floral arrangements when our production work calls for it 😉 But we've kept the legacy alive with our name and want to highlight the great history of the Schofield's Flowers brand 🌻  #foryou #fyp #chicago #chicagohistory #mob #chicagogang #deanobanion #stvalentinesmassacre #production #productioncompany #schofieldsflowers #valentinesdaymassacre #alcapone
